description_en: Exports the cloud desktop list as a CSV file
description_zh: 将云电脑列表导出为CSV文件
kebab_example: aliyun ecd export-desktop-list-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id dg-boyczi8enfyc5000 --desktop-status Running --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --user-name alice --desktop-name DemoComputer01 --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --policy-group-id system-all-enabled-policy --charge-type PostPaid --expired-time 2022-12-31T15:59Z --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --end-user-id alice --lang-type zh-CN --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExportDesktopListInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud desktop pool to which the cloud desktop belongs
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑所属的云电脑池ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The status of the cloud desktop
parameters.name: desktop_status

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that there are no more results
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The username of the user who is currently using the cloud desktop
parameters.help_zh: 当前正在使用云电脑的用户名
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the cloud desktop
parameters.name: desktop_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the policy associated with the cloud desktop
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the cloud desktop
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the subscription cloud desktop. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 包年包月云电脑的到期时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601 标准（UTC 时间）
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en: The cloud desktop IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of authorized usernames for the cloud desktop. You can specify 1 to 100 usernames.

Only one user can connect to and use the cloud desktop at a time
parameters.help_zh:
云电脑的授权用户名列表。可设置1~100个。

在同一时段内，只有一个用户可以连接和使用该云电脑
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The language type displayed on the frontend page. The backend sets the language type of the exported file based on this value
parameters.help_zh: 前端页面显示的语言类型，后端根据该语言类型设置导出文件的语言类型
parameters.name: lang_type

fields.help_en: The tag key. If you specify `Tag`, `Key` is required. The tag key cannot exceed 128 characters, cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It also cannot consist of only spaces
fields.help_zh: 标签键。如果传入`Tag`，则`Key`是必填的。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`，也不能仅包含空格
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value cannot exceed 128 characters, cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. A tag consists of a key-value pair and is used to mark resources. You can use tags to group and manage cloud desktops for easy searching and batch operations. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203781.html
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一个标签由一对键值对组成，用于标记资源。您可以使用标签来分组管理云电脑，便于搜索和批量操作，详情参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203781.html
parameters.name: tag

Url.description_en: The download URL of the exported cloud desktop list file
Url.description_zh: 云电脑列表导出文件的下载地址
